⟪1.⟫ ⟪to lay down⟫; mid. (in Hom.), ⟪to lie down⟫.

G2640.b:

⟪1⟫ ⟪to leave behind⟫, ⟪leave⟫: c. acc. pers. ⟪2.⟫ ⟪to forsake⟫, ⟪abandon⟫: ⟦Matthew 19:5|Mt 19:5⟧, ⟦Mark 10:7|Mk 10:7⟧(LXX) ⟦Mark 14:52|14:52⟧, ⟦Luke 5:28|Lk 5:28⟧ ⟦Luke 15:4|15:4⟧, ⟦Acts 6:2|Ac 6:2⟧, ⟦Ephesians 5:31|Eph 5:31⟧(LXX).

G2642.b:

G2643.b:
⟪κατ-αλλαγή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ

⟪1.⟫ ⟪exchange⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪reconciliation⟫: ⟦Romans 5:11|Ro 5:11⟧; κ. κόσμου, ⟦Romans 11:15|Ro 11:15⟧; διακονία τῆς κ., ⟦2 Corinthians 5:18|II Co 5:18⟧; λόγος τῆς κ., ⟦2 Corinthians 5:19|II Co 5:19⟧.†

G2646.b:

(< καταλύω), [in LXX: ⟦Exodus 4:24|Ex 4:24⟧ (⁨מָלוֹן⁩), ⟦1 Samuel 9:22|I Ki 9:22⟧ (⁨לִשְׁכָּה⁩), etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), ⟪an inn⟫, ⟪lodgingplace⟫: ⟦Luke 2:7|Lk 2:7⟧ (so ⟦Exodus 4:24|Ex 4:24⟧, and MGr.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a guest-room⟫ (⟦1 Samuel 9:22|I Ki 9:22⟧): ⟦Mark 14:14|Mk 14:14⟧, ⟦Luke 22:11|Lk 22:11⟧.†

G2647.b:
⟪κατα-λύω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨לוּן⁩, ⁨שׁבת⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to destroy⟫, ⟪cast down⟫: ⟦Matthew 24:2|Mt 24:2⟧, ⟦Mark 13:2|Mk 13:2⟧, ⟦Luke 21:6|Lk 21:6⟧; τ. ναόν, ⟦Matthew 26:61|Mt 26:61⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:40|27:40⟧, ⟦Mark 14:58|Mk 14:58⟧ ⟦Mark 15:29|15:29⟧, ⟦Acts 6:14|Ac 6:14⟧; οἰκίαν, ⟦2 Corinthians 5:1|II Co 5:1⟧; opp. to οἰκοδομεῖν, ⟦Galatians 2:18|Ga 2:18⟧. Metaph., ⟪to overthrow⟫, ⟪annul⟫, ⟪abrogate⟫: ⟦Acts 5:38|Ac 5:38⟧, ⟦Acts 5:39|39⟧; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, ⟦Romans 14:20|Ro 14:20⟧; τ. νόμον, ⟦Matthew 5:17|Mt 5:17⟧ (II Mac 2:22).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to unloose⟫, ⟪unyoke⟫ (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), ⟪to take up one's quarters⟫, ⟪lodge⟫ (cl., ⟦Genesis 19:2|Ge 19:2⟧, al.): ⟦Luke 9:12|Lk 9:12⟧ ⟦Luke 19:7|19:7⟧.†

G2648.b:
⟪κατα-μανθάνω⟫,

G2649.b:
⟪κατα-μαρτυρέω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX: ⟦Job 15:6|Jb 15:6⟧, ⟦Proverbs 25:18|Pr 25:18⟧ (⁨ענה⁩), al.;] ⟪to bear witness againt⟫: c. acc. rei et gen. pers., ⟦Matthew 26:62|Mt 26:62⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:13|27:13⟧, ⟦Mark 14:60|Mk 14:60⟧.†

G2655.b:

⟪1.⟫ ⟪to cause to grow numb⟫.

G2657.b:

M, Pr., 117).†
